recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source edits would be redundant unless OO later chooses to revise the modifier reason or the surrounding subject/focus guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-45259 was an Applied/Persuasive Orders and Observations change request for R6 asking that Observation.focus be a modifier because ignoring focus can change the meaning of an Observation when the focus differs from the subject.
initial_application: No FHIR-45259-tagged implementation commit was found. The current modifier metadata appears to have been applied through the related Observation commit 7a5dceb8125349335cb7532470282bc4b609f368 for FHIR-37736, which added isModifier=true and an isModifierReason to Observation.focus.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml the relevant build-scope source. OO minutes from 2024-08-06 corroborate the FHIR-45259 Persuasive 4-0-1 vote, and Jira later notes that focus was already tagged as a modifier. Quoted Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already marks Observation.focus as a modifier and explains that it changes who is the target of the observation.

related_jiras.note: Earlier applied Observation issue that added the current Observation.focus modifier metadata and related use-case wording.
